comments.LineComment: | Byte-for-byte the upstream module EXCEPT `ordArrayImpl`, which here is PureScript over the
| WasmBase array primitives (`Wasm.Array`) with prelude-free loop arithmetic (`Wasm.Int`,
| since `Data.Ord`'s array loop needs no `Prelude` arithmetic) — so the element comparator used
| by `Ord (Array a)` *specializes* (ADR 0027) instead of going through the opaque foreign
| `ordArrayImpl`. The remaining scalar foreigns (`ordIntImpl`/…) keep their wat providers. The
| module's interface (exports, types, instances) is unchanged, so this can shadow the registry
| module at the user's resolved version.
